caption: Timothy H. O’Sullivan, Sand Dunes, Carson Desert, Nevada (1867)
alt: A pale nineteenth-century photograph of bare sand dunes under an empty sky; a small covered wagon drawn by four mules stands at their foot, with a line of footprints leading away from it across the sand.
bibliography: O’Sullivan, Timothy H. Sand Dunes, Carson Desert, Nevada. 1867, albumen print from wet collodion negative, Cleveland Museum of Art, 2002.45.
title: Sand Dunes, Carson Desert, Nevada
